name: Irina Avalon
original_name: イリーナ・アヴァロン
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c22773]Saki's[/url] powerful partner and a real ojou-sama. In addition to being her best friend, Irina acts as some kind of proxy for Saki due to her lack of expression. However, she keeps saying things her friend doesn't say, which is constantly troubling Saki. She truly is an ojou-sama.

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
